data.text: Luke, I support 10 tons each this month. Leaving 50 guarantees a full lake next month under either outcome—not because replenishment is guaranteed, but because doubling also gets us to 100. Let’s make our total limit depend on the stock: never catch more than leaves 50, and agree on whole-ton shares before choosing. Once catches are revealed, we can address any overages without retaliating by draining the lake. Kate, will you join that agreement?
